deadline_policy: Absolute deadline including setup and evaluation; stop at two completed epochs or the training deadline, whichever comes first. Reserve final time for evaluation and atomic checkpoint. Do not start late with a fresh full 7.5-hour budget.

training.backend: Actual C ABI with unchanged validated FP32 full-softmax kernels
training.output_policy: Fresh dedicated run directory; preserve the previous stopped queue and checkpoints. No old 14-hour queue restart.

readiness_requirements: Independent full-size C/Torch numerical gate passed: 28 comparisons.
30-minute four-thread actual-training pilot continues only while monitors stay valid; no thread escalation.
Fresh CPU/C run; preserve previous stopped queue.

observed_hardware_snapshot.pmset_report: No thermal or performance warning level recorded at inspection.
observed_hardware_snapshot.scope: Read-only current-state inspection, not a load test, hardware diagnosis or overnight safety certification.

timing_evidence_limits: Previous 7.42h two-epoch estimate used SIX requested threads and short low-load C observations. It does not predict this four-thread configuration or ensure completion by morning.
physical_confirmation: User confirmed ventilated solid desk and no observed physical abnormalities.

thermal_policy.source: macOS ProcessInfo.thermalState; system thermal pressure, not a temperature or fire sensor
thermal_policy.on_serious: Stop new training updates, best-effort atomic checkpoint, exit with thermal-stop reason.
thermal_policy.on_critical: Stop compute immediately; preserve latest complete checkpoint. Do not continue evaluation/generation.
thermal_policy.on_monitor_error: Stop training rather than treating missing monitoring as normal.
thermal_policy.limitations: Software thermal monitoring does not certify battery/charger safety or prevent every possible fire.
